caption: 💌 Do not forget to SAVE this recipe to try this weekend 🍞💛 I wish I never gave toast full of labels 🍞 Finally, a soft, golden, irresistible homemade toast i can be proud of! Perfect for calm weekend mornings or a cozy snack. Recipe: Starter: 1 tbsp yeast + 1 tsp honey + 1/4 cup (60ml) warm water ⏩ let sit 5 min 4 cups (600g) whole grain flour 2 cups (480ml) warm water 1 tsp salt 2 tbsp olive oil Mix everything, let rise twice in the oven with a glass of hot water, then bake at 180°C / 40–45 min. Tips: Slice and top with fruits, cinnamon, or honey for a toddler-friendly snack Soft, wholesome, and naturally sweet Perfect for meal prep or weekend breakfast #kidssnackideas #toddlerapproved #toddlersnacks #healthysnacksideas #EnergiKuatTiapLangkah
